item.title: Ministers propose guaranteed pension income for life for 17m workers
item.body: Ministers have proposed a new guided retirement scheme that would offer millions of private sector workers a guaranteed pension income for life. The rules are designed to help savers get the most out of their retirement savings.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💷 Ministers propose guaranteed pension income for life for 17m workers

Ministers have proposed a new guided retirement scheme that would offer millions of private sector workers a guaranteed pension income for life. The rules are designed to help savers get the most out of their retirement savings.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 3 November, 15:50
